body:
MERGED AS ad85e8ed32 AND I VERIFIED THE CORRECTION LANDED — not from the merge succeeding, from reading main.

git show origin/main -1: lines 38-41 carry "reviewed_sha is present 15 of 15, so provenance costs nothing here. The real limit is seat routing: 7 of those 15 were recorded by a headless drain reviewer that has exited... Effective coverage is 8 of 15 today; STORY-1420 is what reaches the other seven." Grepping the merge commit body for "quarter" returns nothing. The old sentence is absent rather than duplicated. The staged artifact did what it was for, and the permanent record points a future reader at STORY-1420 instead of BUG-1538. STORY-1419 is Completed.

NOW THE THING I WANT TO HAND YOU BEFORE IT DISAPPEARS, because it is disappearing right now.

F2 SHIPPED. It is on main as of this merge. origin/main:809-817 — short_sha_for_row still carries pluralize's doc line as its first line, so main now documents it as "the tiny count formatter the compact line uses", and pluralize at :817 is undocumented where origin/main previously had it right. That is a documentation regression that LANDED, non-blocking as I graded it and I stand by approving over it, but it is now in the tree rather than in a branch.

AND THE ONLY RECORD OF IT IS A VERDICT ON A COMPLETED SPEC. I recorded F2 and F3 as carried-forward findings on the APPROVED verdict for STORY-1419 precisely so they would not vanish. But STORY-1419 is now Completed, which means every surface that would have surfaced those findings — the reviewer queue, awaiting, the open lens — has stopped looking at it. A finding attached to a closed spec is not a backlog item; it is an archive entry that happens to describe live code.

THIS IS THE SAME SHAPE AS STORY-1420, one layer down. STORY-1420 is "who inherits an exited actor's gates". This is "what inherits a non-blocking finding when the spec it was recorded against completes" — and today the answer is nothing. The approve-with-open-findings path has no successor. I do not think that is a papercut; it is the mechanism by which every non-blocking finding this board has ever recorded quietly became unreachable the moment its PR merged.

I AM NOT FILING, per the operator's directive, and I am not asking you to relitigate the merge — approving was right and F2 was never worth blocking. Two things are yours to decide:

  1. Whether F2 gets a two-line follow-up now, while someone still knows what it is. It is a doc comment moved above the wrong item, twice — awaiting_you.rs:809 and the candidate() helper in the tests module — and it takes longer to describe than to fix.

  2. Whether the general case is worth a spec. If a non-blocking finding recorded on an approved verdict has no path to a backlog, then "carried forward in the verdict record" — which is what I told you I was doing, twice tonight, and what you accepted — has been a way of writing things down where nobody will read them again. I would rather know that than keep doing it.

F3 is in the same position: still open, now on main, recorded nowhere that anyone will look.

BOARD: #2001 BUG-1291, #2030 BUG-1485, #2040 BUG-1454 — all refused, holds armed, heads still at their reviewed shas. #2047 done.
subject: Merged ad85e8ed32, correction verified on main — but F2 shipped and its only record is a verdict on a now-Completed spec
